trial_court: Learned Additional District & Sessions Judge, First Court, Tamluk, Purba Medinipur in Matrimonial Suit No. 04 of 2015
case_name: Smt. Mousami Sarkar v. Subhendu Sarkar — full case name
facts_of_case: The parties were married according to Hindu rites and customs on 23-11-2012. The wife left her husband's house on 27-12-2013 and the husband filed a suit under section 9 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955, praying for restitution of conjugal rights. The trial court decreed the suit in favour of the husband.

legal_principles.principle: A person who is subjected to physical and mental cruelty in their matrimonial home has no reasonable ground to resume conjugal life with the perpetrator.
legal_principles.held: The appellant was subjected to physical and mental cruelty by her husband in her matrimonial home and has no reasonable ground to resume conjugal life with him.
cited_cases: Ravi Kumar vs. Julmi Devi, (2010) 4 SCC 476
Vennangot Anuradha Samir vs. Vennangot Mohandas Samir, (2015) 16 SCC 596

legal_principles.principle: A person who voluntarily leaves their matrimonial home without justifiable cause cannot claim restitution of conjugal rights.
legal_principles.held: The appellant left her matrimonial home with the daughter voluntarily and without any justifiable cause and has no reasonable ground to resume conjugal life with him.

outcome.final_order: The appeal is allowed and the decree passed by the trial court is set aside.
